role: The chest container over any IInventory (a chest tile entity, a double chest through InventoryLargeChest, or the player's ender chest), with numRows driving the slot layout.

members.name: numRows
members.note: the native container takes the chest's slot count (27 or 54) rather than a row count

members.name: ContainerChest
members.note: the chest open builds CONTAINER_CHEST with 27 or 54 (a pair) slots; the ender chest path is gui_open_ender

members.name: canInteractWith
members.note: the chest's isUseableByPlayer (both halves' for an InventoryLargeChest, InventoryEnderChest's for the ender window); containers2-s42 walks the player to 7.98 blocks (open) then 9 (closed)
